text:
I can’t begin to detail my experience here with this restaurant. Sadly it’s my local as I live in west bay, however I am forced to write this review, after circa 7-10 orders. I can simply say this is hothead worst ran franchise in area, whether you order talabat or go and collect- the wait times are ridiculous. Service is awful and staff don’t care, they are obsessed with making you use the self service counters however the collection screen for ticketing does not work.
Really badly operated McDonald. They need new management and reliable staff.
author: Moneeb Razaq
